segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Hello, this is Prakash from Thali POS. You were looking for billing software for your cafe, is that right?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Yes, we have two outlets. Does billing work when the internet goes down?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Yes, billing works offline and syncs when the connection returns.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Does it connect directly to our accounting software?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Yes, it integrates directly with accounting software.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Standard plan is 2,500 per month per outlet, with yearly billing.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Hmm, that is a little expensive for two outlets.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: I'll email you the pricing PDF today. How about a demo next Sunday at 3 p.m.?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: This Sunday works for me, at 3 p.m.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Perfect, I'll send you the demo invite for Sunday at 3 p.m.
